title: Check the BitLocker encryption progress
description: Show the encryption or decryption progress percentage of a BitLocker volume.

examples.description: Show the encryption status and percentage of C:

examples.command: while($true) { Clear-Host; Get-BitLockerVolume D: | Select-Object MountPoint,VolumeStatus,EncryptionPercentage; Start-Sleep 30 }
examples.description: Monitor the progress live (refreshes every 30 seconds)
List every volume being encrypted or decrypted

Show every property of the first object returned. Select-Object * widens the output to every column. -First 1 keeps the first result only. Use it to discover the available properties before filtering.
Show the results in a table sized for the console. Format-Table -AutoSize adjusts the column widths for readable output. Good for a quick look at structured data.
Export the results to a CSV file that Excel can open. -NoTypeInformation drops the metadata line. -Encoding UTF8 keeps accented characters intact. Useful for archiving, reports and external analysis.
Count the objects returned. Measure-Object returns Count, Sum, Average, Min and Max depending on the properties. Useful for quick statistics and to validate results.

notes: VolumeStatus: FullyEncrypted, FullyDecrypted, EncryptionInProgress, DecryptionInProgress, EncryptionSuspended. EncryptionPercentage: 0-100%. Encryption can take several hours depending on the size. With -UsedSpaceOnly: fast encryption (30 min - 2 h). Without -UsedSpaceOnly: full encryption (2-8 h or more).

fr.title: Vérifier la progression du chiffrement BitLocker
fr.description: Affiche le pourcentage de progression du chiffrement ou déchiffrement d'un volume BitLocker.
fr.notes: VolumeStatus: FullyEncrypted, FullyDecrypted, EncryptionInProgress, DecryptionInProgress, EncryptionSuspended. EncryptionPercentage: 0-100%. Le chiffrement peut prendre plusieurs heures selon la taille. Avec -UsedSpaceOnly: chiffrement rapide (30 min - 2h). Sans -UsedSpaceOnly: chiffrement complet (2-8h ou plus).
